title: Talk it through 1.3
role: Travel advisor helping a couple choose between two destinations
can_do: I can compare two places with as ... as and comparatives.
I can show a contrast with whereas.

nodes.partner_line: We can't decide between the island and the mountains. Which is cheaper?
nodes.translation: No podemos decidir entre la isla y las montañas. ¿Cuál es más barato?

options.text: The mountains are cheaper than the island.
The island is a bit more expensive than the mountains.
They are about the same price.

nodes.partner_line: Is the island as crowded as the town?
nodes.translation: ¿La isla está tan llena de gente como el pueblo?
nodes.model_reply: No, it is not as crowded as the town.
starters: No, it is not as ... as

nodes.partner_line: The island is more beautiful, whereas the mountains are cooler. Which do you prefer?
nodes.translation: La isla es más bonita, mientras que las montañas son más frescas. ¿Cuál prefiere?

options.text: I prefer the island, because it is more relaxing.
I prefer the mountains, because they are cooler.
I can't decide. They are both nice.

nodes.partner_line: How far is the beach from the hotel on the island?
nodes.translation: ¿A qué distancia está la playa del hotel en la isla?

options.text: It's only five minutes on foot.
It's a bit further than the town, about ten minutes.
It's as close as the pool.

nodes.partner_line: Is the food as good as in the capital?
nodes.translation: ¿La comida es tan buena como en la capital?

options.text: It's just as good, and it's cheaper.
It's not as good, but the view is better.
It's even better, in my opinion.

nodes.partner_line: Great. We'll book the island, then.

options.text: Excellent choice. I'll prepare the booking.
Perfect. I'll send you the details today.
